title: Civic listening synthesis
description: Clusters anonymous community submissions into a Symthink JSON tree of themed Claims with verbatim quote leaves.

variables.name: tier
variables.description: `5_plus` allows flat categories only; `20_plus` allows sub-categories for broad themes.

variables.name: submissions
variables.description: Anonymous submissions with stable numeric ids the model references in metadata.

surfaces: Civic listening session synthesis (GET /api/listening-sessions/:id/synthesis, close-session final synthesis)

usage.notes: The user message is a JSON payload. This template pretty-prints it; symthink-io sends the same payload as compact JSON. The API also enforces JSON with response_format, and the server checks that quote leaves are verbatim.
